scope: One digest-pinned kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster, namespace saf-test, and narrowly scoped ConfigMap metadata events. The API server's native audit webhook sends actual audit.k8s.io/v1 EventList batches over TLS to a case-owned receiver whose CA is pinned in the webhook kubeconfig. A unique inert ConfigMap create is matched to its exact ResponseComplete auditID at the receiver. The case compares emptyDir loss with a case-owned PVC, deletes and recreates the PVC-backed receiver Pod, checks prior exact IDs, and confirms a new post-restart event. It does not establish production SIEM, audit.log, managed-exporter, tamper resistance, long-term retention, or failure-domain durability.

checks.claim: An actual API-server audit event reaches an emptyDir-backed receiver
Deleting and recreating the receiver Pod loses its emptyDir audit record
The live API-server webhook delivers one successful metadata event to the PVC receiver
The exact pre-restart auditID remains on the same bound PVC after receiver Pod recreation
The restarted PVC-backed receiver accepts a new real audit event
